<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אייר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918380_theRebbe_210" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_99_D7_99_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918380_theRebbe_210__p008">
  <section v="21">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the command "You shall be holy, for I am holy" refers to G‑d's holiness being above man's holiness, drawn down through teshuvah which is not an arousal from below, and the Midrash connects this to the concept of G‑d's greatness being revealed in the world through the arousal from below to complete the purpose of a dwelling place in the lower realms.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">3)</t>
    <t s="2">And this is: "You shall be holy, for I am holy,"</t>
    <t s="3">My holiness is above your holiness,</t>
    <t s="4">And it is explained in Likkutei Torah that My holiness which is above your holiness is drawn down not through an arousal from below,</t>
    <t s="5">Even though it is drawn down through the service of teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="6">For the concept of the service of teshuvah is that it is non-existence,</t>
    <t s="7">And consequently this is not a matter of arousal from below.</t>
    <t s="8">And this is why the Midrash prefaces the matter of My greatness which is above your greatness</t>
    <t s="9">(Even though this seemingly does not relate to this verse),</t>
    <t s="10">That just as My greatness,</t>
    <t s="11">Even though it is above your greatness,</t>
    <t s="12">Is a matter of revelation</t>
    <t s="13">(And relates to the lower realm),</t>
    <t s="14">So too will it be regarding the drawing down of the aspect of My holiness,</t>
    <t s="15">That it will be in revelation in the world</t>
    <t s="16">(And there will also be in this the advantage of arousal from below),</t>
    <t s="17">Through which the intention of a dwelling place in the lower realms will be completed.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
